Robot.label: Robot
Robot.description: This LWM2M Object includes robot information and links to the location object.

Robot_Type.label: Robot Type
Robot_Type.description: Robot Type, for example: Ginger, CloudCleanX, CloudPepper.

Robot_Serial_Number.label: Robot Serial Number
Robot_Serial_Number.description: Robot Type, for example: Ginger, CloudCleanX, CloudPepper.

Battery_Level.label: Battery Level
Battery_Level.description: Current Battery Level of the robot.

Charging.label: Charging
Charging.description: If the robot is charging or not,the setting of which is a Boolean value (1,0) where 1 is Yes and 0 is No.

On_time.label: On time
On_time.description: The time in seconds that the device has been on. Writing a value of 0 resets the counter.

Positioning.label: Positioning
Positioning.description: If the robot is needed to be positioned, the setting of which is a Boolean value (1,0) where 1 is Yes and 0 is No.

Location.label: Location
Location.description: The location of the robot, contains the reference to the Location object(6).
